calibration_sources: Azure Cloud Adoption Framework (CAF) AI Landing Zone: Private Link, Customer-Managed Keys (CMK) & Abuse Monitoring Opt-Out (ZDR)
Microsoft Presidio & Enterprise Reversible PII Pseudonymization / Format-Preserving Encryption (FPE) Gateway Patterns

workload.enterprise_scenario: Regulated Financial / Healthcare / Manufacturing Enterprise (15B Tokens/Month: 72% L1/L2 General/Coding/Public Analysis + 28% L3/L4 Regulated PII & Core IP)
workload.compliance_mandates: 0.0% Unmasked PII Egress to Public Logs, No Vendor Model Training on Customer Data (ZDR), Private Network Transit, Frontier Reasoning >= 94%
workload.architect_core_pattern: Never build a 100% on-prem island for L1/L2 general traffic; combine a compact local L4 enclave + reversible PII tokenization vault + Private Link ZDR cloud burst.

tiers.name: Tier 1: 公网直接调用标准 SaaS 大模型 API (默认 30 天厂商日志留存 · 28% 敏感数据合规违例)
tiers.name_en: Tier 1: Public Internet Standard SaaS API (Default 30-Day Vendor Logging · 28% Compliance Breach)
tiers.landing_zone_stack: Public Internet Egress + Default Provider Abuse Monitoring Logs + Shared API Keys
tiers.recommended_for: Non-sensitive public sandbox testing only; blocked by enterprise CISO/Legal for production internal data.

tiers.name: Tier 2: 100% 本地机房全量自建算力孤岛 (连普通写代码也跑本地 · 20 周交付滞后 & 算力荒废)
tiers.name_en: Tier 2: 100% On-Premises Air-Gapped GPU Island for All L1-L4 Traffic ($58.5K/mo Amortized)
tiers.landing_zone_stack: 4x 8-GPU On-Premises Servers ($1.4M CapEx) Running All L1-L4 Workloads Locally without Cloud Burst
tiers.recommended_for: Anti-pattern for commercial enterprises: wastes local GPU CapEx on 72% non-sensitive L1/L2 traffic while losing frontier reasoning.

tiers.name: Tier 3: 企业级合规云专线着陆区 (ExpressRoute + Private Link + 零数据留存 ZDR + HSM 自管密钥)
tiers.name_en: Tier 3: Enterprise Cloud Landing Zone (ExpressRoute + Private Link + Zero Data Retention [ZDR] + CMK)
tiers.landing_zone_stack: Private Link over ExpressRoute/DirectConnect + Contractual ZDR (Zero Logging/Review) + HSM CMK
tiers.recommended_for: 90% of cloud-first regulated enterprises where contractual ZDR + Private Link + CMK satisfies data sovereignty audits.

tiers.name: Tier 4: 混合云数据分级与可逆脱敏双向路由 (L4 核心机密走本地小集群 + L3 可逆脱敏上云 + L1/L2 云端弹性)
tiers.name_en: Tier 4: Hybrid Data-Classification & Reversible PII Pseudonymization Router (Local L4 + ZDR Cloud L1-L3)
tiers.landing_zone_stack: Compact Local GPU Enclave (28% L4 Traffic) + Local Presidio Reversible PII Tokenization Vault + Private-Link ZDR Cloud (72% L1-L3)
tiers.recommended_for: Strictest banking/healthcare/government hybrid standard: 0.0% raw PII egress, 96.2% frontier reasoning, and 66.2% lower TCO vs. 100% On-Prem.
